About the Trail Boot

The Trail Boot is a mid-height walking boot built for mixed terrain: rocky ridges, wet moorland and long forest tracks. The upper is full-grain leather with a gusseted tongue that keeps grit out, the midsole is a dual-density foam that stays supportive on a full day of descent, and the outsole uses a deep multidirectional lug pattern that sheds mud instead of packing it. A rubber rand wraps the toe and heel for abrasion resistance where boots usually wear first.

Sizes run true to length with a medium-width last; if you walk in thick socks, consider a half size up. The boot arrives ready to wear, although a short break-in period over two or three walks will let the leather settle around the foot. Care is simple: brush off dried mud, wipe with a damp cloth and re-proof the leather every few months with a wax-based treatment.

In the box

One pair of Trail Boots, a spare pair of laces and a care leaflet.
